source_policy: Unmodified generated RGBA originals; UV rectangles select image regions. No saved crop, repaint or raster composite.

base_uv_correction.reason: Generated items cross nominal grid boundaries. Automatic full-cell alpha bounds included a separate collar inside the head rectangle and a cape cap inside the hair rectangle.

excluded_layer: base atlas torso cell 2 contains an unwanted arm; never drawn.
outfit_granularity: Torso through waist and skirt is one coherent outfit layer, rather than independently replaceable chest/waist/hip armor slots.
stock_contact: Weapon stock socket is seated on body-space stockPocket; recoil moves body and stock together. Reload deliberately lowers the stock.
mirroring: Left view is mirrored right-view artwork, not a newly generated opposite equipment side.
